scripts.build: npm run build -w @sondage/shared && npm run build -w @sondage/db && npm run build -w @sondage/worker && npm run build -w @sondage/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sondage/shared && npm run build -w @sondage/db && concurrently -n api,worker "npm run dev -w @sondage/api" "npm run dev -w @sondage/worker"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sondage/shared && node --import tsx --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w @sondage/shared && node --import tsx --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts
scripts.test:compliance: npm run build -w @sondage/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/compliance/*.test.ts packages/shared/src/compliance-checks.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test-force-exit --import tsx --import ./tests/integration/setup-redis-env.ts --test tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @sondage/api && node --import tsx --test --test-force-exit apps/api/src/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:compliance && npm run test:build && npm run test:api && npm run test:integration
